title: Your Stock's Closing Price Just Got a New Twist: Understanding the Closing Auction
description: From August 3, 2026, how the closing price for certain shares is decided is changing. This new system, called the "Closing Auction Session" (CAS), will apply .

faq.q: Which stocks will this Closing Auction Session apply to?
faq.a: It will apply to all shares that are part of the Futures & Options (F&O) segment on the stock exchanges.

faq.q: When does this new system start?
faq.a: The Closing Auction Session for F&O stocks will come into effect from August 3, 2026.

faq.q: How long will the Closing Auction Session last?
faq.a: The auction session itself will be for 20 minutes, from 3:15 PM to 3:35 PM for F&O stocks.

faq.q: Will this affect how I trade Nifty or Bank Nifty futures?
faq.a: Yes, the trading hours for stock and index derivatives, including Nifty and Bank Nifty futures, will be extended by 10 minutes, closing at 3:40 PM instead of 3:30 PM.

faq.q: Why is SEBI making this change?
faq.a: SEBI is introducing this to improve the transparency and accuracy of closing prices for F&O stocks, ensuring they better reflect the true demand and supply in the market at the end of the day.
